title: Prefrontal cortex takes part in conscious access

statements.text: Conscious access needs a network of long-range neurons that includes prefrontal cortex, which makes information globally available in a late ignition.

sources.quote: conscious access occurs when incoming information is made globally available to multiple brain systems through a network of neurons with long-range axons densely distributed in prefrontal, parieto-temporal, and cingulate cortices
Raccah et al.'s claim that the prefrontal cortex (PfC) does not support consciousness is incorrect

sources.locator: Can Nonconscious Stimuli Produce a Global Ignition?
sources.quote: Another pillar of the proposed theoretical synthesis is that global ignition is unique to conscious states.
